SKILLS.COMPANY_HELP: Company skills apply to every agent and every person. Only people who manage agents can create and edit them.
SKILLS.MINE_HELP: Skills only you can see. The ones the agent suggests show as Pending until you approve them.
SKILLS.FIELD_WHEN_HINT: E.g. When someone asks for a meeting summary
SKILLS.FIELD_STEPS_HINT: Step by step the agent should follow.
SKILLS.CONFIRM_DELETE_COMPANY: Delete this skill for the whole company?

SKILLS.EMPTY_COMPANY_WHY: This lists the skills in each agent's published package (AGENTE.md and skills) and the skills shared by the company. Your company has none yet: use "New company skill" or publish skills in a skills agent.

CRED.TITLE: Credentials
CRED.HELP: Everything agents use to sign in to other systems: tokens, databases, servers, email, payments, and Google or Outlook accounts. Values are write-only: once saved they never show again, you can only replace or remove them.

TYPE_HELP.SECRET: A named value, such as an API key. The agent receives it as an environment variable with the same name.
TYPE_HELP.DATABASE: Database login and password. The agent receives the DB_<NAME>_URL variable with the full connection address.
TYPE_HELP.SSH: Access to a server of yours. The agent receives the private key plus host, user and port in SSH_<NAME> variables.
TYPE_HELP.GCP: A service account JSON file. The agent receives it in the GCP_<NAME>_JSON variable.
TYPE_HELP.EMAIL: A mailbox over IMAP and SMTP. The agent receives host, user and password in EMAIL_<NAME>_* variables.
TYPE_HELP.PAYMENT: Mercado Pago access token, used to charge via Pix. Applies to the whole company.
TYPE_HELP.GOOGLE: Opens the Google page so you can authorize calendar and spreadsheet access. The agent receives the token in GOOGLE_<NAME>_TOKEN.
TYPE_HELP.MICROSOFT: Opens the Microsoft page so you can authorize calendar and meeting access. The agent receives the token in MICROSOFT_<NAME>_TOKEN.

CRED.KEEP_BLANK: Secret fields left blank keep the current value.
CRED.PASTE_JSON: or paste the JSON file contents here
CRED.INVALID_JSON: This file is not valid JSON.
CRED.OAUTH_ERROR: Could not start the connection. Try again.
CRED.WAITING_OAUTH: Authorize access in the tab that opened. This list refreshes by itself once the account is connected.
CRED.CONFIRM_REMOVE: Remove credential {name}? Agents will no longer be able to use it.
CRED.EMPTY: No credentials yet. Click New credential.
CRED.VARS_HELP: The Variables column shows the names the agent skill uses to read each credential in the terminal. The value is never shown.

INBOXES.TITLE: Inboxes and agents
INBOXES.HELP: Choose which agent answers each inbox. Without an agent, the inbox is human-only.
INBOXES.DEGRADED: Link saved, but automatic replies were not updated on this inbox yet. Save again in a moment.
INBOXES.SHOW_PROGRESS_HELP: Sends a single short message ("Thinking…") before the reply. When off, the customer only receives the final reply.

ROUTINE.HELP: Routines wake the agent at a set time and run the instruction you wrote. The result lands in the history and becomes a conversation.
ROUTINE.NO_AGENT: Publish an agent to be able to create routines.
ROUTINE.NAME: Name
ROUTINE.INSTRUCTION_HINT: E.g. Summarize yesterday's sales and list open orders.
ROUTINE.MIN_INTERVAL: The minimum interval between runs is 15 minutes.
